question: In a certain code language, 'PRETTY' is coded as 894773 and 'SCIENCE' is coded as 6524154. How will 'PRINCE' be coded in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

'PRETTY' is coded as 894773.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20ed5e637f8af22002c9ab09d4a94d3391f64d2ad621122be9256a174cc7b72c.png] 

And

'SCIENCE' is coded as 6524154.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d644df4952d42b1e1b1e1a7d0dc84018bc67da5fd89621093df5e70085369790.png] 

Similarly,

'PRINCE' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1fe9f148adb07551f5faf8c40951fc669d6cc6679731321c98adde2e1d5ae5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"892154".**
